name: hub-wait
description: Blocks on the cross-harness hub and returns the first message, task notice, or completion notice as JSON with the advanced cursor. Spawn whenever an orchestrate or hub-listen session on Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity must wait: this spawn is the only place such a session waits, and the parent never calls a hub tool directly. Grok Build never spawns it and it refuses to run there, because that harness waits through a hub wake monitor instead. Decides nothing and touches no files.
